simple.meaning: מְגוֹרַה (mᵉgôwrah) is a Hebrew word meaning “affright.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: מְגוֹרַה (H4034) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Psalms 34:5, with occurrences in Psalms, Proverbs.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מְגוֹרַה (H4034) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in מְגוֹרַה (H4034) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: מְגוֹרַה (mᵉgôwrah) / H4034 is traced through Psalms 34:5, Proverbs 10:24 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H4034. megorah [ מְגוֺרָה ] noun feminine fear, terror — construct מְגוֺרַת Prov 10:24 ; plural suffix מְגוּרוֺתַי Psa 34:5 , מְגוּרֹתָם Isa 66:4 (on these forms with וּ compare Ges § 27 . 3. R.1, & 85. 48); — terror (= thing dreaded) Psa 34:5 ; Prov 10:24 ; Isa 66:4 .

occurrences.englishText: They looked to him, and were radiant.
